newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal river energy plan gets islamic bank funds.
newsitem.headline: Senegal river energy plan gets islamic bank funds.

text.p: Islamic Development Bank (IDB) funds totalling 12 billion CFA francs have been granted for a West African river energy project including Mali, Mauritania and Senegal, a Senegal government minister said on Friday.

"We are happy to state that the IDB's contribution covers 33 percent of the needed finances," said Minister of Finance Papa Ousmane Sacko, whose country hosts the headquarters of the Organisation for the Development of River Senegal (OMVS).
The funds, along with other contributions would be used for the building of a hydro-electric dam from September due for completion in 2000, Organisation officials said.
Energy would be divided as follows: Mali 52 percent, Senegal 33 percent and Mauritania 15 percent, they said.
